text:
esteban_sales: FYI — Prospect (RegBank) asks for a short POC to validate our runtime against their on-prem HSM (Thales Luna) + CMK import. They want answers on: timeline, cost delta vs hosted, rotation window, and what we can include in the security questionnaire. Can eng + security help coordinate?

praveen_eng: I can take the POC tech lead. Quick q: expected QPS and average seq len? Will they be doing envelope encryption (service encrypts data keys) or direct DEK use?

esteban_sales: They said high-freq low-latency: ~200 qps peak, 20k tokens/day, mostly generation with short prompts. They want CMK-only for secrets (BYOK) and envelope encryption for user payloads.

amanda_security: Ok — two immediate redlines: 1) we need KMS attestation that keys were imported (proof of custody) and 2) documented rotation window & rollback plan. Also need confirmation on tamper-evidence for their HSM. I can draft the security questionnaire answers.

ola_solutions: Proposed minimal POC plan: 
- 1 week scoping (network, ports, certs)
- 2 week validation (throughput + failover tests to our fallback model)
- Deliverable: perf report + key handoff checklist
Questions: do we support importing Thales wrapped keys today?

siva_sre: Network ops notes: we'll need a static IP allowlist on their side and 443 (mutual TLS). If they're air-gapped, we'll need a relay VM in their VPC or an on-prem agent. Also confirm latency SLO we should test (p50/p95).

maria_acct: Pricing question from buyer: "how much extra if we bring our own KMS vs using Redwood-managed?" They want an apples-to-apples estimate for monthly cost at their projected usage.

billing_bot: Quick back-of-envelope: hosted-managed KMS incremental ~= +$0.02 / 1k requests for KMS ops; BYOK integration professional services one-time ~$12k (network + attestation + runbook). Reserved capacity delta depends on GPU profile, estimate +15-25% for dedicated throughput with HSM latency overhead. (formal quote pending).

praveen_eng: Technical note: For BYOK we need to support import formats: PKCS#11 wrapped symmetric keys or raw key material depending on their policy. If they require key splitting (two-custodian), we can coordinate but it's extra ops. Also rotation: we support scheduled rotation with replay-safe prefixes, but their HSM will dictate TTL — suggest 30d as default for high-security customers, but we can accommodate 90d.

amanda_security: For the questionnaire: I'll mark the following items as "requires customer confirmation": key custody process, HSM attestation artifact (certificate), split-key policy, backup/escrow process. We'll provide template answers for SOC2 control mapping.

esteban_sales: They asked about acceptance of hardware proofs for import. Can we accept their attestation cert and still call it "customer-managed"?

security_bot: We accept X.509 attestation chains signed by FIPS-certified HSM vendors. Must include signing cert + import manifest + import timestamp. We'll store only metadata (no raw key material).

ola_solutions: I'll prep a one-page POC doc and send to RegBank. Need input from security on exact attestation fields and from billing on the PS SOW itemization.

maria_acct: Legal/contract note: they requested a rotation SLA (max 24h window to rollback a bad rotation). Can eng/sre confirm if that's feasible operationally?

siva_sre: 24h rollback is feasible if we keep 2 previous key versions in the system and maintain KV cache compatibility. Need to agree on test cutover window and runbook. Ops will require runbook signoff before go-live.

praveen_eng: Implementation checklist I propose: 
1) Confirm import format + attestation sample
2) Network test & TLS mTLS cert exchange
3) Provision test key in staging + run perf tests (p50/p95)
4) Simulate rotation and rollback on staging
5) Deliver final SOW + go/no-go
I'll attach a sample command we might ask the customer to run for key export verification: 
```
# on customer HSM (example Thales CLI)
thales-cli export-key --key-id=cmk-123 --wrap-algo=RSA-OAEP --recipient-cert=redwood-prod.pem --out=cmk-123.wrap
```

amanda_security: Add to checklist: retention of attestation for 7 years (auditor request) and encrypt transit of attestation files.

maria_acct: Perfect. Esteban — can you schedule an intro call with RegBank for Monday? I'll include the draft PS estimate and a copy of the questionnaire answers.

esteban_sales: On it. I'll book Mon 10am PT. Thanks everyone — will post follow-up after call. :thumbsup:

security_bot: NOTE: tagging policy team for any contractual KMS clauses that deviate from standard BYOK.

billing_bot: I'll prepare a formal quote template (line items: PS integration, reserved delta, per-request KMS ops) and drop in the thread before EOD Friday.

ola_solutions: Thanks — if anyone has previous POC runbooks for Thales integrations, please drop links here.

praveen_eng: I'll upload a short runbook excerpt after the call with details on import formats and rotation scripts.

maria_acct: Closing loop — RegBank emphasized audit/compliance first, cost second. Let's lead with attestation + runbook in the SOW.

esteban_sales: Noted. Follow-up thread will have call notes + action items.
